description_en: Queries the configuration of the pg_hba.conf file of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS PostgreSQL实例的pg_hba.conf文件的配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-pg-hba-config --client-token 1 --db-instance-id pgm-bp1lymyn1v3i0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePGHbaConfig

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

HbaItem.description_en: The default configuration items of the pg_hba.conf file
HbaItem.description_zh: pg_hba.conf文件的默认配置项列表

Address.description_en: The IP addresses from which the specified users can access the specified databases. The value is fixed as 0.0.0.0/0

Database.description_en: The names of the databases that the specified users are allowed to access. The value is fixed as all or replication

Mask.description_en: The mask of the instance. The value is fixed as null

Method.description_en: The authentication method. The value is fixed as md5

Option.description_en: The value of this parameter is based on the value of the Method parameter. The value is fixed as null
Option.description_zh: 认证方式对应配置参数，固定为空

PriorityId.description_en: The priority of the configuration items in the pg_hba.conf file. This value is automatically generated

Type.description_en: The type of connection to the instance. The value is fixed as host

User.description_en: The user that is allowed to access the instance. The value is fixed as all

HbaModifyTime.description_en: The time when the previous modification was made to the pg_hba.conf file
HbaModifyTime.description_zh: pg_hba.conf文件最近一次修改的时间

LastModifyStatus.description_en:
The status of the previous modification to the pg_hba.conf file. Valid values:

success
setting
failed
LastModifyStatus.description_zh:
pg_hba.conf文件最近一次修改的状态。返回值如下：

success：成功
setting：设置中
failed：失败

ModifyStatusReason.description_en: The reason why the previous modification was made to the pg_hba.conf file
ModifyStatusReason.description_zh: 此参数显示pg_hba.conf文件最近一次修改状态对应的原因
ModifyStatusReason.example: The specified users (testuser) is not exist.

HbaItem.description_en: The current configuration items of the pg_hba.conf file
HbaItem.description_zh: pg_hba.conf文件的当前配置项列表

Address.description_en: The IP address of the client

Mask.description_en: The mask of the IP address

Option.description_en: The value of this parameter varies based on the value of the Method parameter. The value is fixed as null
Option.description_zh: 认证方式对应的配置参数。不需要配置时，置为空

Type.description_en:
The connection type. Valor:

host: The record matches TCP/IP connections, including SSL connections and non-SSL connections.
hostssl: The record matches only TCP/IP connections that are established over SSL.
hostnossl: The record matches only TCP/IP connections that are not established over SSL connections
Type.description_zh:
连接类型，返回值如下：

host：该条记录验证TCP/IP连接，包括SSL连接和非SSL连接。
hostssl：该条记录只验证通过SSL建立的TCP/IP连接。
hostnossl：该条记录只验证通过非SSL建立的TCP/IP连接
